arxiv-2105-06102.title: Thermal instability in a ferrimagnetic resonator strongly coupled to a loop-gap microwave cavity
arxiv-2105-06102.creator: Cijy Mathai, Oleg Shtempluck, Eyal Buks
arxiv-2105-06102.description: Abstract We study nonlinear response of a ferrimagnetic sphere resonator (FSR) strongly coupled to a microwave loop gap resonator (LGR). The measured response in the regime of weak nonlinearity allows the extraction of the FSR Kerr coefficient and its cubic damping rate. We find that there is a certain range of driving parameters in which the system exhibits instability.

arxiv-2207-12223.title: Compound Poisson Processes: Potentials, Green Measures and Random Times
arxiv-2207-12223.creator: Yuri Kondratiev, José Luís da Silva
arxiv-2207-12223.description: Abstract In this paper we study the existence of Green measures for Markov processes with a nonlocal jump generator. The jump generator has no second moment and satisfies a suitable condition on its Fourier transform. We also study the same problem for certain classes of random time changes Markov processes with jump generator.

arxiv-2402-14819.title: A NOVEL METHOD FOR SCHIZOPHRENIA CLASSIFICATION USING NONLINEAR FEATURES AND NEURAL NETWORKS
arxiv-2402-14819.creator: Hari Prasad SV hpvariyar@gmail.com
arxiv-2402-14819.description: Abstract One notable method for recording brainwaves to identify neurological problems is electroencephalography (hereafter EEG). A trained neuro physician can learn more about how the brain functions through the use of EEGs. However conventionally, EEGs are only used to examine neurological problems (Eg. Seizures). But abnormal links to neurological circuits can also exist in psychological illnesses like Schizophrenia.

arxiv-2404-08351.title: OmniSat: Self-Supervised Modality Fusion for Earth Observation
arxiv-2404-08351.creator: Guillaume Astruc 1,3,4, Nicolas Gonthier 1,2, Clement Mallet 1, Loic Landrieu 1,3
arxiv-2404-08351.description: Abstract The diversity and complementarity of sensors available for Earth Observations (EO) calls for developing bespoke self-supervised multimodal learning approaches. However, current multimodal EO datasets and models typically focus on a single data type, either mono-date images or time series, which limits their impact.

arxiv-2502-19673.title: SubZero: Composing Sub ject, Style, and Action via Zero -Shot Personalization Thanks: Qualcomm AI Research, an initiative of Qualcomm Technologies, Inc.
arxiv-2502-19673.creator: Shubhankar Borse, Kartikeya Bhardwaj, Mohammad Reza Karimi Dastjerdi, Hyojin Park, Shreya Kadambi, Shobitha Shivakumar, Prathamesh Mandke, Ankita Nayak, Harris Teague, Munawar Hayat, Fatih Porikli
arxiv-2502-19673.description: Abstract Diffusion models are increasingly popular for generative tasks, including personalized composition of subjects and styles. While diffusion models can generate user-specified subjects performing text-guided actions in custom styles, they require fine-tuning and are not feasible for personalization on mobile devices. Hence, tuning-free personalization methods such as IP-Adapters have progressively gained traction.

britannica-1911-tate-nahum.title: Tate, Nahum (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-tate-nahum.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-tate-nahum.description: Article 'Tate, Nahum' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 26), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. Tate was commissioned by Dryden to write the Second Part of Absalom and Achilophel. The portraits of Elkanah Settle and Thomas Shadwell, however, are attributed to Dryden, who probably also put the finishing touches to the poem. Of his numerous poems the most original is Panacea, a poem on Tea (1700). In spite of his consistent Toryism, he succeeded Shadwell as poet laureate in 1692.

pmc-11580533.title: Exploring optical coherence tomography parameters in eyes with myopic tilted disc
pmc-11580533.creator: Yu Qiao Zhang, Xiu Juan Zhang, Ru Yue Shen, Yuzhou Zhang, Fang Yao Tang, Simon K H Szeto, Danny Siu-Chun Ng, Ka Wai Kam, Alvin L Young, Li Jia Chen, Chi Pui Pang, Clement C Tham, Jason C Yam, Poemen P Chan
pmc-11580533.description: BackgroundTo investigate the impact of optic disc torsion (ODT), horizontal disc tilt (HDT) angle, and ovality index (OI) on different retinal nerve fiber layer (RNFL) and ganglion cell-inner plexiform layer (GCIPL) segments in healthy myopic eyes.MethodsODT and OI were measured from fundus photographs. HDT angle, peripapillary RNFL, and macular GCIPL were measured by swept-source optical coherence tomography (SS-OCT).

pmc-11646787.title: Intrathecal or intravenous AAV9-IDUA/RGX-111 at minimal effective dose prevents cardiac, skeletal and neurologic manifestations of murine MPS I
pmc-11646787.creator: Lalitha R Belur, Avery K Huber, Hillary Mantone, Mason Robertson, Miles C Smith, Andrea D Karlen, Kelley F Kitto, Li Ou, Chester B Whitley, Elizabeth Braunlin, Justin Furcich, Troy C Lund, Davis Seelig, Carolyn A Fairbanks, Nicholas Buss, Kwi Hye Kim, R Scott McIvor
pmc-11646787.description: Mucopolysaccharidosis type I (MPS I) is a rare metabolic disorder caused by deficiency of α-L-iduronidase (IDUA), resulting in glycosaminoglycan (GAG) accumulation and multisystemic disease. Current treatments include hematopoietic stem cell transplantation and enzyme replacement therapy, but these do not address all manifestations of the disease.

pmc-11678218.title: Age-Stage, Two-Sex Life Tables of Megalurothrips usitatus (Bagnall) and Frankliniella intonsa (Trybom) on Different Bean Pods Under Laboratory Conditions: Implications for Their Competitive Interactions
pmc-11678218.creator: Mengni Li, Zhengke Peng, Chaosong Guo, Yong Xiao, Fei Yin, Haibin Yuan, Zhenyu Li, Myron P Zalucki, Patrick De Clercq
pmc-11678218.description: Simple SummaryThis paper reports differences in the development of Megalurothrips usitatus (Bagnall) and Frankliniella intonsa (Trybom) on three legume plants, providing a theoretical basis for interspecific competition between these two species. The results showed that M. usitatus were more competitive on snap bean, F. intonsa were more competitive on cowpea, and both thrips were less adapted on green bean.

pmc-11801775.title: Recent HCMV infection in early pregnancy associates with congenital transmission & adverse pregnancy outcome: A prospective cohort study
pmc-11801775.creator: Harsha Chandrashekhar Palav, Varsha Sakharam Padwal, Shilpa Milind Velhal, Sapna Yadav, Gauri Sanjay Bhonde, Varsha Kalsurkar, Sachee Agrawal, Reena Set, Jayanthi Shastri, Forum Shah, Ira Shah, Purnima Satoskar, Vainav Patel, Vikrant Madhukar Bhor
pmc-11801775.description: Background & objectivesHuman Cytomegalovirus (HCMV) infection, leading to >90 per cent seropositivity in women of reproductive age from India, is the largest cause of congenital infections worldwide. HCMV infection status was prospectively monitored together with congenital transmission (cCMV) and adverse pregnancy outcomes (APO) in a public health setting where maternal or neonatal screening was not in practice.

pmc-12395754.title: Does palliative care improve the quality of life for cancer patients in three tertiary hospitals in South Africa?
pmc-12395754.creator: Mpho Ratshikana, Witness Mapanga, Sukoluhle Pilime, Peedi Mathobela, Oluwatosin Ayeni, Anu Abrahams, Lawrence Mandikiana, Phillip Makume, Sonti Imogene Pilusa, Jacob Merika Tsitsi
pmc-12395754.description: BackgroundQuality of life (QoL) is a crucial treatment outcome for cancer patients, who often experience significant symptom burden and distress. Despite its benefits, access to palliative care remains limited in many settings, including South Africa. This study assessed changes in QoL before and after palliative care interventions and examined factors associated with QoL improvements.

pmc-12445196.title: Livestock Grazing Management Influences Survival of Giant and Red Pandas in Southwest China
pmc-12445196.creator: Yanshan Zhou, Xiang Yu, Chao Chen, Wenlei Bi, Rui Ma, Jiabin Liu, Zushen Li, Guanwei Lan, Rong Hou, Haijun Gu, Xiaodong Gu, Jinke Zeng, Minghua Chen, Buqie Shang, Zuofu Xiang, Dunwu Qi
pmc-12445196.description: Despite intensified global efforts in wildlife conservation, livestock grazing remained a critical factor driving habitat changes. The quantitative studies specifically addressing the impact of grazing on the habitat changes of giant ( Ailuropoda melanoleuca ) and red pandas (Ailurus styani) were notably scarce.

pmc-12597871.title: Safety and Efficacy of SHURUI Single-Port Serpentine-Arm Robotic Surgery System in Lung Surgery: A Prospective Single-Centre Study
pmc-12597871.creator: Chang Li, Zhuolin Xie, Cheng Ding, Jun Chen, Xinyu Zhu, Yifan Shi, Ziyao Fang, Diego Gonzalez-Rivas, Jun Zhao
pmc-12597871.description: ObjectivesThe integration of robot-assisted thoracic surgery (RATS) and uniportal video-assisted thoracic surgery (VATS) is poised to become a key direction for future advancements. The SHURUI single-port (SP) Robotic Surgery System, China’s first domestically developed SP endoscopic system, has shown promise in urological and gynaecological surgeries but lacks thoracic application data.

pmc-12615869.title: Choline attenuates NEFA-induced hepatic steatosis via GNMT regulation in hepatocytes
pmc-12615869.creator: Xueer Du, Lamei Wang, Yanfei Dai, Jing Lu, Hongrui Li, Dangdang Wang, Jun Zhang, Chuanjiang Cai, Shimin Liu, Junhu Yao, Jianguo Wang, Yangchun Cao
pmc-12615869.description: To elucidate the molecular mechanisms by which choline regulates hepatic lipid metabolism under negative energy balance conditions, we established non-esterified fatty acid (NEFA)-induced hepatic steatosis models in both calf primary hepatocytes and human LO2 hepatocytes. Choline supplementation significantly reduced intracellular triglyceride accumulation and cytotoxicity induced by NEFA exposure. Transcriptomic profiling identified glycine N-methyltransferase (GNMT) as a key differentially expressed gene.

pmc-13266206.title: Screening and validation of rabbit monoclonal antibody pair against human FGF21 for human plasma FGF21 high sensitivity bioanalysis
pmc-13266206.creator: Shancheng Zhao, Ziyun Ji, Yaxun Wang, Jie Li, Yanling He, Jing Shen, Chang Liu, Lina Wang, Xiaoqing Ma, Shengnan Wang, Jiguang He, Feng Xu
pmc-13266206.description: SummaryFGF21 has been reported to have a high correlation with various dysmetabolism-associated diseases. However, a portion of FGF21 in human blood samples remains below the detection limit of the state-of-the-art commercial ELISA kit. Quantitative determination of FGF21 with high sensitivity will benefit FGF21 functional research and drug development.

pmc-13459574.title: Risk factors for second primary esophageal cancer after head and neck squamous cell carcinoma: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-13459574.creator: T. De Bock, A.D.I. Maan, R.H.A. Verhoeven, S. Van Roy, O. Lenssen, D. De Cock, A.D. Koch, M.T. Brands
pmc-13459574.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundPatients with head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC) are at an elevated risk of developing second primary tumors. Esophageal second primary tumors (ESPTs) represent a significant clinical challenge due to their frequent late detection and associated poor prognosis. This systematic literature review aims to identify and synthesize current evidence on risk factors for synchronous and metachronous ESPTs in patients with HNSCC.

pmc-13515021.title: Potential threats of porcine Getah virus outbreaks and its specific antagonism of host antiviral response through proteasome-dependent degradation of P46 by nsP2
pmc-13515021.creator: Yang Wu, He Zhang, Mingwei Li, Shanshan Song, Qian Yang, Yaqin Dong, Yongrui Wang, Xuepeng Wang, Ju Zhang, Jin Tian, Feng Zhang, Longjun Guo, Li Feng
pmc-13515021.description: Alphaviruses are a genus of positive-strand RNA viruses classified in the Togaviridae family. It contains many important human and animal pathogens, such as chikungunya virus (CHIKV), Sindbis virus (SINV), Venezuelan equine encephalitis virus (VEEV), Semliki Forest virus (SFV) and Ross River virus (RRV), posing significant threats to public health and animal welfare.

pmc-13524735.title: Electrodeposited Bi2Te3-carbon black nanocomposites with enhanced thermoelectric and mechanical properties
pmc-13524735.creator: Khairul Fadzli Samat, Muhammad Afiff Alias, Muhammad Aliff Ikhwan Che Azman, Mohd Hafiz Jali, Nguyen Van Toan, Takahito Ono
pmc-13524735.description: SummaryThermoelectric thin films based on bismuth telluride (Bi2Te3) are widely used for room temperature energy harvesting, but improving electrical, thermal, and mechanical properties simultaneously remains challenging. In this study, Bi2Te3-carbon black nanoparticle nanocomposite films were synthesized by electrodeposition and then systematically characterized.

pmc-13560951.title: Metal-Organic Framework-Based and Metal-Organic Framework-Derived Nanomaterials for Cancer Theranostics and Antibacterial Applications: Advances, Challenges, and Perspectives
pmc-13560951.creator: Yiming Wang, Jie Zhang, Can Zhang, Xinyi Tian, Liudi Gu, Xue Liang, Nan Zhang
pmc-13560951.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Metal-organic frameworks (MOFs), constructed through coordination-driven self-assembly of metal ions/clusters and organic linkers, have emerged as a uniquely versatile class of porous nanomaterials with broad biomedical potential. Despite substantial clinical progress, both oncological treatment and antimicrobial intervention remain constrained by inadequate tumor-targeting selectivity, multidrug resistance, immunosuppressive tumor microenvironments, and the global proliferation of antibiotic-resistant pathogens, limitations that conventional nanocarrier platforms have addressed only in part.

pmc-13643658.title: Adolescent Reports of Demanding and Responsive Features in Helicopter and Overprotective Parenting: Divergence of Correlations With Indicators of Adjustment
pmc-13643658.creator: Melanie J Zimmer‐Gembeck, Katherine M Ryan, Bart Soenens, Grégoire Zimmermann, Stijn Van Petegem
pmc-13643658.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). IntroductionResearch collecting data from parents has found that helicopter parenting (HP) and overprotective parenting (OP) of their adolescents can be reformed to identify two features: demanding and responsive overparenting (Ryan et al. The correlations of these features with other measures were also found to differ, with demanding overparenting uniquely correlated with parent reports of less positive parenting and poorer youth adjustment and with responsive overparenting correlated with more parent‐reported positive parenting.

uslaw-usc-t29-s560.title: 29 U.S.C. § 560 — Reports and investigations
uslaw-usc-t29-s560.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t29-s560.description: United States Code, Title 29 (Labor); Chapter 12 (Department Of Labor). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The Secretary of Labor shall annually, at the close of each fiscal year, prepare and submit to Congress the financial statements of the Department that have been audited. He shall also, from time to time, make such special investigations and reports as he may be required.
